lessons.title: Let the last line speak
body: Function signatures declare parameter and return types. Here, both arguments and the result are signed 32-bit integers: i32.
The final expression is the return value. A trailing semicolon turns that expression into a statement, so leave it off. We’ll check your function with positive, negative, and zero inputs.
lessons.task: Implement add(a, b) so it returns the sum of both arguments.
lessons.hint: Replace the placeholder 0 with a + b, without a semicolon.
